items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where I met Johnny Coles, and Clarence Johnston, his drummer... They were all in that band.

ctx.x: That’s where I met Johnny Coles, and Clarence Johnston, his drummer, Jimmy Boyd his pianist and F horn player, and Tom McIntosh, and Eddy Jefferson. They were all in that band.
But you knew Moody prior with Dizzy? Did you know him during that period of time?
